messages:
maria_cust: Hey team — we rotated IdP certs ~03:14 UTC and customers started hitting SSO failures. Getting 401 / 'Recipient mismatch' in the SAMLResponse. Rolled the certs back but some requests still fail intermittently. Any quick triage steps?

sara_support: Sorry you're hitting this — can you paste the base64 SAMLResponse (or decoded XML) and the ACS URL you configured in the SP? Also which IdP vendor and cert type (RSA/ECDSA)?

maria_cust: IdP is Okta. We rotated to a new ECDSA key. SP ACS in our console: https://app.acme-corp.com/sso/acs (no trailing slash). Here's the decoded fragment (redacted):
```xml
<samlp:Response Destination="https://app.acme-corp.com/sso/acs" ...>
  <saml:Assertion>
    <saml:Subject>...<saml:NameID>user@acme.com</saml:NameID></saml:Subject>
    <saml:AuthnStatement>...</saml:AuthnStatement>
    <saml:AuthzDecisionStatement Resource="https://app.acme-corp.com/sso/acs/" Decision="Permit">...</saml:AuthzDecisionStatement>
  </saml:Assertion>
</samlp:Response>
```
Notice the Assertion/Resource has a trailing slash.

sara_support: That Recipient/Resource vs configured ACS mismatch will cause strict SP checks to reject. Interesting it's intermittent — could be cached metadata from the IdP with old ACS variant. Can you confirm the SP metadata file we published (the one the IdP pulls) has the exact ACS endpoint without slash?
maria_cust: Yes our published SP metadata is without the slash. IdP fetched metadata yesterday. We did the cert rotate at 03:14 and then pushed metadata again.

kevin_eng: Quick hypothesis: Okta rotated keys and also re-serialized the metadata, changing the order of KeyDescriptor elements and (separately) normalized the ACS URL to include the trailing slash. Our signature/recipient verification code is strict: exact string match for Recipient/Audience. Steps I recommend: 1) fetch the current IdP metadata; 2) decode a failing SAMLResponse from a recent request; 3) verify Recipient and Signature refer to same URL and key.

jen_sre: Also check our metadata cache TTL and the watcher job logs. If the metadata poller saw a temporary variant with a slash and cached it, new responses could still be being signed against that cached variant. Run: `curl -sS 'https://idp.okta.com/metadata' -D - | sed -n '1,80p'` and compare modification time.

maria_cust: I fetched metadata and attached the fingerprint. The metadata contains two KeyDescriptor entries (one RSA, one ECDSA) and the KeyInfo order is different from before. The metadata's AssertionConsumerService entry lists both URLs (with and without slash). So Okta is advertising both.

sara_support: That matches a known edge case: when IdP advertises multiple ACS locations and signs with a key corresponding to the variant with a trailing slash, our SP rejects because Recipient in the assertion doesn't exactly match the primary ACS configured. Short-term workaround: enable lenient recipient comparison (accept both normalized forms) or add the trailing-slash variant to your SP ACS list in the console. Long term we'll adjust our validation to accept canonicalized URLs.

kevin_eng: For triage please do this and paste results:
1) `echo <base64-saml> | base64 -d | xmllint --format -` (paste the Recipient/Audience and Signature KeyName).
2) `curl -fsS https://idp.okta.com/metadata | xmllint --xpath 'string(//EntityDescriptor/@ID)' -`
3) Check our poller logs: `kubectl logs -n infra metadata-poller-*** | grep metadata | tail -n 50`

maria_cust: Ran step1 — Recipient is `https://app.acme-corp.com/sso/acs/` (trailing slash). Signature KeyName references the new ECDSA key id `kid-ecdsa-2026-03-14`. Step2 shows EntityDescriptor ID `okta-tenant-prod-492`. Step3 poller logs show a successful fetch at 03:13 and again at 03:15 with slightly different content.

sara_support: OK that explains intermittent: poller fetched variant A at 03:13 (no slash) then 03:15 (slash) and cached depending on race. Workaround: flush metadata cache for this tenant and force a re-eval: `POST /internal/admin/tenants/acme/metadata/refresh` (internal endpoint). I'll escalate to eng to relax recipient check temporarily while cs fixes SP metadata to list both forms.

kevin_eng: I'll open a short-lived soft-fallback patch to accept normalized recipients for 48 hours. Can you also send one raw failing request ID from a user and the X-Request-ID from our proxy so we can pull the exact SAMLResponse from logs?

maria_cust: Request ID f7a2c3d0, proxy X-Req: xreq-992233. Attaching log excerpt.

idp-bot: [automated] Metadata change detected for okta-tenant-prod-492 at 2026-03-14T03:14:27Z; keys: [+kid-ecdsa-2026-03-14, -kid-rsa-2026-02-01].

jen_sre: I've flushed the tenant metadata cache and restarted metadata-poller for that tenant (log: restart ok). Please test one user and report back.

maria_cust: Tested — SSO worked for one user right after flush. I'll add the trailing-slash ACS entry to our SP metadata to be safe. Will monitor and report if anything else crops up. Thanks all :heart:

sara_support: Great — tracking this as an incident for follow-up: prevent strict recipient mismatch causing outages when IdP advertises multiple ACS variants. I'll link to the ticket after the standup. :thumbsup:
